title: The Mystery of Food
lesson: To understand ‘The Mystery of Food’, begin with the situation presented in the chapter and identify what is happening. Focus on what food contains and balanced meals, then look for evidence for food preservation. Finally, explain what you learned and how the idea can guide a decision or observation outside the chapter.
